description:
Navigate to the 'Computer Discovery' category (monitor/keyboard icon) in GCompris and open the 'Programming Maze' activity. Your goal is to complete Level 1 by creating a sequence of instructions to guide Tux to the fish/goal. 

Steps:
1. Open the Programming Maze activity.
2. On Level 1, drag instruction blocks (Forward, Turn) into the program area to build a path.
3. Run the program to make Tux reach the goal.
4. Once Level 1 is complete and Level 2 loads, take a screenshot of the Level 2 maze saved to '/home/ga/Documents/programming_maze_level2.png'.
5. Also save a screenshot showing your success on Level 1 (or the transition) to '/home/ga/Documents/programming_maze_complete.png'.
